Google said Search gets its biggest model update yet with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, rolling out globally (2,423 likes).

Google Search is getting its biggest model update yet with Gemini 4 Hydrogen — rolling out globally for all users today.

Here’s what’s new in Search:

🔍 Better understands intent: Ask nuanced, multi-part questions in your natural flow of thought — even with specific requests or typos — and get relevant responses across all supported AI Mode languages.

👀 More visual responses: Get adaptive, easy-to-scan layouts with images, comparison tables, and custom tools.

🌐 Upgraded query fan-out: Hydrogen’s reasoning upgrades how Search runs simultaneous subtopic queries to connect you to a broader range of helpful web links.

Google@Google
We’re rolling out Orchestrator in @Antigravity to Google AI Ultra subscribers, letting you run multiple models in a single session instead of routing the entire task to one model.

Orchestrator pairs a frontier model with a fast execution model: Carbon sets the plan, hands off code edits and testing to Hydrogen, and steps back in to repair the plan if it hits friction — reaching near-Carbon task success rates on Terminal-Bench 4.0 while consuming 24% less quota and completing 19% faster on average.
